summary_en: meito announced updates to its capital management policy on November 11, 2026. The company's board resolved on measures to realize management conscious of cost of capital and stock price, though specific targets and implementation details are referenced in attached materials.
title_en: Measures to Realize Management Conscious of Cost of Capital and Stock Price
translation_en_brief:
On November 11, 2026, meito's board of directors resolved on measures to realize management conscious of cost of capital and stock price. The company announced current recognition of its situation and future specific initiatives, though the detailed content is contained in attached materials not provided in this disclosure excerpt.

The announcement indicates meito is taking a formal approach to align its management practices with cost of capital considerations and stock price performance, addressing investor expectations around capital efficiency and market valuation.
